pairs_touching.notes_for_p3b: No single row explicitly cites A by name from within B's rows or vice versa -- the continuity is inferred from naming and roadmap-then-execution structure, not a quoted lineage claim.
pairs_touching.what_says_this: A (S0208/S0209) is a roadmap document proposing Phase 4 'Constitutional Invariant Map' as NEXT and drafting 'KnowledgeOS Constitutional Invariant Map v1.0' (seven rows: Authority/Observation/Projection/Representation Separation...). B's rows (S0235/S0237/S0238) describe the actual, later, formally commissioned P4 process ('KOS-EP01-P4', 'the P4 Map', step 3 of a frozen 5-step sequence) that P5 then tests/challenges/consolidates -- an 8-family landscape built from a larger register (25 candidates + 4 Established). Near-identical naming ('KnowledgeOS Constitutional Invariant Map v1.0' vs 'Constitutional Invariant Map v1.0') plus the roadmap-then-execution narrative indicates B is the formal continuation/execution of what A drafted.
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: If B's P4 Map turns out to be an independently-initiated exercise unconnected to A's draft (i.e. two separate teams/sessions producing similarly-named maps by coincidence), or if a row shows B's inputs explicitly exclude A's draft.

pairs_touching.homonym_positive_evidence: Explicit corpus/P2 quote: A is 'distinct from the earlier philosophically-derived B0006 kos-constitutional-invariant-map/11-law core, though thematically resonant' -- different derivation method (empirical Steps-101-119 conformance arc vs earlier philosophical derivation), explicitly not merged.
pairs_touching.what_says_this: why_grouped (first entry) is an explicit SOURCE-CLAIMED-SEPARATION: A (knowledgeos-architecture-constitution-v01, Step 120's frozen C1-C7) is 'independently and empirically derived from the Steps 101-119 architecture-conformance arc -- distinct from the earlier philosophically-derived B0006 kos-constitutional-invariant-map[B]/11-law core, though thematically resonant.' Two independently-produced constitutional-invariant artifacts (one philosophically-derived, one empirically-derived), explicitly kept distinct, not merged, despite covering similar territory. (The second why_grouped entry is an administrative re-registration note about A's own label, not a substantive claim about the A-B relationship.)
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: If a later governance act formally merged the empirically-derived C1-C7 constitution with the earlier philosophically-derived 11-law kos-constitutional-invariant-map into one artifact.

pairs_touching.what_says_this: Group evidence G0266 describes A's candidate seven-principle K1-K7 constitution as 'independently derived from this architecture-conformance arc, distinct from the earlier B0006 philosophically-derived 11-law constitutional core', and notes A merely 'previews Step 120 constitutional consolidation' -- no row names kos-constitutional-invariant-map (the P4 Map) specifically as the target of that consolidation or preview.
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: A row from Step 120 explicitly merging A's K1-K7 candidate constitution into the P4 Constitutional Invariant Map.

pairs_touching.notes_for_p3b: Same underlying P3/P4/P5 governance sequence as RP0335 (constitutional-invariant-map-v1 vs kos-constitutional-invariant-map) in this batch -- P4 is the pivot connecting both pairs.
pairs_touching.what_says_this: A's row S0238 states directly: 'Positions this commissioning instrument as step 4: (1) R-1 EKS corpus closed -> (2) corrected-P3 re-review (P4 gate OPEN) -> (3) P4 Constitutional Invariant Map v1.0 -> (4) P5 (this prompt) -> (5) kernel decision. Status: RATIFIED -- P5 COMMISSIONED (gate OPEN).' This explicitly places A ('the P5 Decision Matrix') as step 4, directly continuing from B ('the P4 Map', step 3) in one named, corpus-stated sequence.
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: If a different document (not family B) turns out to be the actual 'P4 Constitutional Invariant Map v1.0' referenced in S0238's sequence.

pairs_touching.what_says_this: CO-OCCURRENCE only (2 co-occurrences). No lineage_claims found in either direction via full-row scan.
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: A row stating the Step-5 kernel decision was made using, or updates, the constitutional invariant map would establish a claim.

pairs_touching.notes_for_p3b: This is a process-artifact pair (B=the preparatory research phase, A=its resulting deliverable) rather than two competing theories -- type_compatibility is not meaningfully assessable (UNKNOWN) since B is a governance process, not a typed formal construct.
pairs_touching.what_says_this: B documents the research-discipline PROCESS (SHALL-discipline downgrades, evidence-priority Tier1-4 hierarchy, Filter/Separate/Test methodology) that directly precedes and produces A (the actual P4 Constitutional Invariant Map v1.0 deliverable). B's own S0213 states the explicit hand-off: 'Formally recommends declaring the Research Collection Phase COMPLETE and moving to P4: Constitutional Invariant Map' -- and A's S0235/S0238 confirm the same transition from the other side ('Positions this commissioning instrument as step 3/4 of a frozen 5-step sequence... P4 (this prompt)').
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: If A's actual P4 Map content were shown to disregard or contradict B's SHALL-discipline/Tier-hierarchy groundwork (e.g. admitting an un-vetted candidate B's process explicitly excluded), the clean process-to-deliverable continuation would be broken.

pairs_touching.notes_for_p3b: Worth a closer text-level check: B's 12 informally-named principles map almost one-to-one onto the eventual 11 adopted laws (kos-law-01 through kos-law-11, see RP1305/RP1329), suggesting B may be an earlier, less formal draft of the same constitutional content -- but this pair's captured evidence contains no citation connecting them, so kept at UNWITNESSED pending direct textual confirmation.
pairs_touching.what_says_this: Grouped via a weak UNKNOWN-CANDIDATE-GROUP note (G0699) about an unrelated governance-tracking uncertainty, not a direct claim linking these two. Zero dual-labeled rows and no lineage_claims either direction. A is the formal, governed P4 Constitutional Invariant Map process (25-candidate register, 8-family landscape, UM-22 compression-test protocol). B ('The 12 Constitutional Principles of KnowledgeOS': Identity/Context/Evidence/Authority/Reasoning-Transparency/Observation-Inference/Contradiction/Revision/Temporal/Non-Interference/Agent/Semantic-Sovereignty) is thematically similar to -- and largely foreshadows -- the eventual 11-law Adopted Constitutional Core described elsewhere in this batch's other Constitutional-Invariant-Map rows (RP1305/RP1329), but no row cites B as a source, draft, or precursor of A, and no row in either family's sample mentions the other.
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: A row explicitly stating the P4 Map process consolidated or superseded 'the 12 Constitutional Principles' document, or citing it as an input, would establish REFINEMENT/CONTINUATION.
